description: Engine §10 accepts `("a" ++ $_0062)` as a string receiver for `.ngrams`.
grammar:
%const $S "ab"
%const $Q ("a" "b")
%const $TAG (A B)
%const $P #A
%const $E "a" ∖ "a"
%rule text $x:unit B %conditions (("a" ++ $_0062)).ngrams(1) = ("a" "b")
%rule unit A
%rule family unit
%rule want A B
